question: Is a larger six-bit, three-mediator, hidden-structural-law causal intervention task identifiably difficult for strongest fully trained conventional same-information learners, before spending any scientific cohort on another unconventional mechanism?

task.name: SixBitCompositionalDoWorld
task.immediate_reward: Number of goal-matching mediator bits minus 0.05 times action count, including STOP; max 3.0.

laws.A: m0 = x0 XOR x1; m1 = x2 AND x3; m2 = m0 XOR x4
laws.B: m0 = x1 OR x2; m1 = x3 XOR x4; m2 = m1 AND x5
laws.C: m0 = x0 XOR x5; m1 = x1 AND x4; m2 = m0 XOR m1
laws.D: m0 = x0 AND x3; m1 = x2 XOR x5; m2 = m0 OR m1
laws.E: m0 = x0 OR x4; m1 = x1 AND x5; m2 = m0 XOR m1
laws.F: m0 = x1 XOR x3; m1 = x2 OR x4; m2 = m0 AND m1

task.mechanics: Hidden structural law fixed within one phase. All 6 inputs public and manipulable, all 3 mediators observed. A setting action do(x_i:=0 or 1) persists and all downstream mediators recompute. No hidden law or formula passed to learner.
task.change_from_prior: 64 input states vs 8, 8 goal configurations vs 4, 12 actions vs 6, 3 compositional mediators vs 2 pairwise mediators, 6 hidden structural laws vs 4, 4 novel structural transfer laws vs 2. These expand task space without by themselves proving difficulty.

training.public_information: Exact dict with x, mediators, goal, reward, actions_taken; no law label, phase label, benchmark oracle, unchosen action, or counterfactual reward; private simulator only for outcome generation.
training.underlying_trial_selection: SHA256 deterministic namespace over fixture key, phase, trial index; no reserved science seed.
training.context_namespace_unique: 12 of 512 possible (x,goal), unique within each fixture-law; novel law is unfamiliar, not necessarily unseen inputs.

matched_controls.tabular_all: Beta(1,1) per 6-bit x and mediator, all public observed evidence; common planner.
matched_controls.tabular_recent16: Beta(1,1) per 6-bit x and mediator, most recent 16 public states; common planner.
matched_controls.knn_all: Hamming k=3 nearest public x from all evidence; tie by recency; Laplace-smoothed mediator bit prediction; common planner.
matched_controls.knn_recent32: Hamming k=3 from last 32 public observations; common planner.
matched_controls.symbolic_pair_recent16: Bayesian posterior per mediator over all 45 (XOR,AND,OR) pairwise 6-input hypotheses; Bernoulli correct=.9, incorrect=.1, 16 recent public examples; common planner.
matched_controls.symbolic_pair_all: Same 45-hypothesis pairwise posterior over all public examples; common planner.
matched_controls.id3_depth4_all: Deterministic greedy information-gain binary decision tree depth <=4 with Laplace leaf predictions; fit on all public events; no hidden law; common planner.
matched_controls.logistic_triple: Conventional logistic with all 42 monomial features through order 3 for each of three mediators; full-batch 160 epochs at challenge checkpoints, stable learning rate 0.15 and L2 0.01; between actions updates 8 online stochastic gradient steps per observed public row; common planner.
matched_controls.reactive: Fixed no-learning 0.5 mediator probabilities, negative diagnostic only.
matched_controls.oracle: Privileged exact-law exhaustive 0,1,2 action planner for admission only, never a competing learner.

controls_fit_contract: Fit all conventional controls on the entire permitted common training sequence; for recency controls retain only frozen declared window by design; no labels, no extra actions or privileged source formulas; never select oracle as baseline. Compare best achieved mean terminal reward across eight conventional controls.
planner: Same deterministic up to-two-step exhaustive policy for every conventional learner; optimistic expected reward at each candidate final input x with cost 0.05/action. If no-action action wins, STOP; tie stable smallest action index. Episode learner may use its own actual public first do-action consequence before deciding second action; never sees counterfactual.

mechanical_admission.no_reservations: No DEV/TRANSFER/NEGATIVE ids used. Exactly three named fixtures; forbidden science IDs error.
mechanical_admission.law_identifiable: All 15 unordered law pairs distinguishable by at least one single public do-action from every original x; no formula or law label passed to learners.
mechanical_admission.consequential: For each of six laws at least 20% of (x,goal) cases admit positive-reward one-step do-intervention and a changed observable mediator.
mechanical_admission.headroom: On 3 frozen mechanical fixtures, four unfamiliar C/D/E/F laws and challenge N=2/4, 12 unique x/goal contexts each, with fully trained strongest conventional control selected by aggregate own scored reward. Overall exact-law oracle minus strongest >=0.25 terminal reward. Each fixture oracle-headroom >=0.10. Candidate learning gain is NOT tested.
mechanical_admission.baseline_control_quality: After fully trained common A/B training, on held-out A and B fixtures at N=2/4, best conventional achieves >=1.70 terminal reward mean over 3 goals; helps rule out toy baselines that learn nothing.
mechanical_admission.resource_budget: Single mechanical pre-admission run per OS, test runtime <=25min, deterministic policy and score traces match Linux/Windows; record walltime, stored bytes, process profile. No science acceptance from fixture.
mechanical_admission.decision: If any mechanical fact, fully-trained baseline floor, headroom floor, public-input privacy, cold retention or source qualification fails -> BENCHMARK_INADEQUATE_NO_SCIENCE; preserve negatives without tuning the formulas or thresholds.

engineering_exit: Exactly frozen prereg-first code, negative tests and privacy, cross-OS deterministic baseline fits and task checks, full repo native regression at final candidate SHA Linux+Windows with pinned code atlas, GitHub receipts only, PR draft/unmerged.
